mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.requiredIntro: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Set it up now to finish signing in.
mfa.enrollIntro: Protect your account with a time-based code from an authenticator app.
mfa.step1: Install an authenticator app (any app that supports TOTP).
mfa.step2: Scan the QR code or type the setup key.
mfa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code and save your recovery codes.
mfa.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
mfa.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app instead:
mfa.codesOnce: These codes are shown only once. Each works one time if you lose your authenticator. Store them somewhere safe.
mfa.copyFailed: Copy failed; select the codes and copy them manually.
mfa.savedCodes: I have saved my recovery codes
mfa.challengeIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.recoveryIntro: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works once.
mfa.offHelp: Two-factor authentication is optional for your account but strongly recommended.
mfa.lowCodes: You are running low on recovery codes. Generate a new set.
mfa.regenHelp: New codes replace all old ones. Enter a current authenticator code.
mfa.disableHelp: Confirm with your password and a current authenticator code.
mfa.enabledToast: Two-factor authentication is on. Other sessions were signed out.
